story.fullStory:
Kenny Chesney's "Get Along" reached #22 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Get Along" is a song written by Shane McAnally, Ross Copperman, and Josh Osborne and recorded by American country music artist Kenny Chesney.

The song peaked at #22 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Get Along was released in 2018.
